# Termux-STT (v1.0.0)
> Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure-Python 128d Speaker Diarization Framework

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt
- Installation: `pip install termux-stt
# or:
npm install termux-stt`
- Architecture: Unifies Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with a closed-form pure-Python 128d speaker diarization algorithm running 100% on-device.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_stt as stt

transcriber = stt.UnifiedSTT(engine="whisper", model="tiny.ko")
result = transcriber.transcribe("meeting_recording.wav", diarization=True)
for segment in result.segments:
    print(f"[{segment.speaker}] {segment.start:.2f}s: {segment.text}")
```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
